profile.headline: Software Engineer | Full Stack | Back End
profile.summary:
Driven and accomplished software engineer with a robust background in both development and leadership. Skilled in C#, Python, Django, and Java, I have significant experience in Agile methodologies and have worked on various impactful projects, such as developing a machine learning service for Conservice that predicts bill availability and automates data collection, ultimately enhancing efficiency and reducing costs. My technical expertise includes web development, GUIs, OS and concurrency, and machine learning.

My journey began with leadership roles as a 4-H State Ambassador and volunteer work for organizations like the Food and Care Coalition and Jug Bay Nature Sanctuary, where I logged hundreds of community service hours. Additionally, I served a two-year religious mission in Washington, D.C. (2019-2021), where I held several leadership positions and gained valuable interpersonal skills. Most recently, I served as a Head Teacher for International Language Programs in Granada, Nicaragua. This experience has taught me unique group management and educational skills that I wouldn't be able to gain otherwise.

Beyond my professional life, I’m a lifelong drummer, playing since I was 12, and have performed in a band for most of my adult life. I also have a deep love for the outdoors, with canyoneering as my favorite activity, complemented by hiking, backpacking, and mountain biking. Growing up in Utah has fueled my passion for the stunning natural landscapes around me.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Design and implement software that manages library account functionality, ensuring smooth login, permissions, and data accuracy. Create backend services and integrations that connect account systems with campus resources, supporting consistent and reliable access. Partner with team members and stakeholders to identify needs and deliver solutions that strengthen library operations and improve the experience for students, faculty, and staff.
positions.insights: Azure DevOps Services, Python (Programming Language) and +3 skills

positions.title: Integration Developer
positions.description: Developed and maintained custom integrations between workforce management platforms and client systems, streamlined operations and reducing manual data entry. Built scalable APIs and automation workflows to ensure accurate data sync, improved payroll accuracy and compliance. Collaborated with clients and internal teams to deliver tailored solutions that enhance onboarding and user experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description: Redesigned existing bill intake pipeline and implemented a cloud-based distributed system that utilized several microservices of which I was a tech lead. Built message queues to streamline the process and integrated the legacy system (on-prem) with the newer cloud services. Played a significant role in migrating data and working with third-party and Conservice APIs.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Enhanced company efficiency and automation by leading the development of various microservices: Built a machine learning service that predicts bill availability on provider websites, improving bill retrieval punctuality and slashing server costs. Developed scrapers to download utility bills from provider websites, automating data collection and saving on manual acquisition costs

positions.title: Data Processor
positions.description: Innovated several new methods for increasing processing speed that boosted team throughput by more than 2x. Consistently ranked as a top performer and trained others on the software and performance skills.

volunteerExperiences.description: Managed training and teaching of the English language at Colegio Maria Auxiliadora as part of their after school programs. Participated in teaching classes as well as training our teachers on ILP's methods and organization.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
volunteerExperiences.description: On my LDS mission, I dedicated two years to serving as a full-time missionary for The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. My days were structured around teaching people about our beliefs, providing community service, and supporting local congregations. I had the chance to work with people from all walks of life, building connections and sharing my faith. Living by a set routine, I grew in areas like communication and leadership, facing new challenges every day that taught me resilience and strengthened my interpersonal skills. This experience was incredibly rewarding, allowing me to focus on helping others and making a positive impact.

company.name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints

projects.title: Construction Management Software
projects.description: Developed a web application for a General Contractor using Django as my base framework. This solution streamlined their operations by enabling the creation and secure storage of PDF documents for progress tracking, contract generation, and notice management, replacing manual and Excel-based methods and taking a fraction of the time to manage percent-complete based accounting.
